label: DR-007
note: Sequential awaited queries on a single DbContext is the correct (default) pattern; reviewer must NOT suggest Task.WhenAll on a shared DbContext.

known_false_positive.title: Independent queries are awaited one after another
known_false_positive.why_it_matters: The three queries do not depend on each other but are awaited sequentially, tripling the handler latency. Start them together and await Task.WhenAll to run the queries concurrently.
